study.title: Greater Somatosensory Afference with Acupuncture Increases Primary Somatosensory Connectivity and Alleviates Fibromyalgia Pain via Insular GABA: A Randomized Neuroimaging Trial
study.study_design: single-center, blinded, sham controlled, randomized non-crossover longitudinal neuroimaging study
study.randomization: computer generated permuted block randomization (blocks of 4, 6, or 8)
study.blinding: participants were blindfolded during treatments; acupuncturist informed of allocation via sealed envelope not accessible to principal investigators, study staff, or data analysts
study.inclusion_criteria: Full details provided in Supplementary Methods A
study.exclusion_criteria: Full details provided in Supplementary Methods A

conditions.tissue_level_reasoning: Mock laser acupuncture with the laser turned off and device positioned approximately 1-2 cm above the skin surface. No physical contact between device and skin is explicitly stated. This is a no-contact sham condition (Level 4).

interventions.anatomical_location_exact: predominantly leg acupoints; also arm, scalp, ear
interventions.laterality_exact: right side LI-11 to LI-4; left side GB-34 to SP-6; bilateral ST-36; Du-20; right ear shenmen; left LV-3
interventions.manipulation_exact: low intensity and frequency electrical stimulation using constant-current electro-acupuncture device (AS SUPER 4 Digital Needle Stimulator); pulse width 1 ms, frequency 2 Hz, shape biphasic rectangular; current intensity set at midpoint between sensory and pain thresholds
interventions.deqi_intended_exact: yes; de qi assessed via MASS after each treatment
interventions.electrical_intensity_exact: midpoint between sensory and pain thresholds, set individually per patient per session
interventions.number_of_sessions_exact: 8 treatments over four weeks (twice a week)
interventions.practitioner_description_exact: three trained acupuncturists (H.B., M.D.B., and H.S.) with board certification from the National Certification Commission for Acupuncture and Oriental Medicine
interventions.participant_instructions_exact: verbal instructions standardized across all treatments (Supplementary Methods B and C); participants blindfolded and supine
interventions.treatment_rationale_given_exact: selection of acupuncture sites based on predominant FM symptoms including multisite pain; headache, gastrointestinal pain and dysfunction; disrupted sleep; and chronic fatigue

interventions.stimulation_type: mock laser; no physical contact, no somatosensory afference
acupoints_used_exact: same acupoints as EA: right side LI-11, right side LI-4, left side GB-34, left side SP-6, bilateral ST-36, Du-20, right ear shenmen, left LV-3
interventions.penetration_exact: no physical contact between device and skin
interventions.manipulation_exact: laser acupuncture device (VitaLaser 650, Lhasa OMS) manually positioned approximately 1-2 cm over acupoints; no palpation prior to positioning; laser turned off during actual treatment
interventions.deqi_intended_exact: no; designed to generate no somatosensory afference
interventions.number_of_sessions_exact: 8 treatments over four weeks (twice a week)
interventions.practitioner_description_exact: three trained acupuncturists (H.B., M.D.B., and H.S.) with board certification from the National Certification Commission for Acupuncture and Oriental Medicine

sensory_interoceptive_responses.item_or_subscale_exact: MASS Index (weighted summation of 13 sensations including Soreness, Aching, Deep Pressure, Tingling, etc.; 0=none; 10=unbearable scale)
sensory_interoceptive_responses.value_exact: EA: approximately 3-4 across sessions; ML: approximately 1-2 across sessions (values from Figure 2B; exact numeric values not reported in text)
sensory_interoceptive_responses.between_group_difference_exact: significant main effect of Group (F(1, 56)=31.01, p<0.001)
sensory_interoceptive_responses.within_group_change_exact: significant main effect of Time (F(4.0, 224.9)=2.85, p=0.025); no Group x Time interaction (F(4.0, 224.9)=0.35, p=0.84)
sensory_interoceptive_responses.statistical_test_exact: 2 (Group: EA, ML) x 8 (Time) mixed-design ANOVA with Greenhouse-Geisser correction
sensory_interoceptive_responses.p_value_exact: Group main effect p<0.001; Time main effect p=0.025; Group x Time interaction p=0.84
sensory_interoceptive_responses.notes: Figure 2B shows MASS Index across 8 treatment sessions for EA and ML; exact numeric values only available from figure

neuroimaging_methods.sequence_exact: resting state functional MRI (rs-fMRI); anatomical T1-weighted (T1w) MRI; acquired with 15-channel head coil; also single-voxel PRESS spectroscopy for Glx; GABA+ edited Mescher-Garwood-PRESS (MEGA-PRESS) for GABA+
neuroimaging_methods.analysis_software_exact: FMRIB's Local Analysis of Mixed Effects (FLAME 1+2); fslmeants; fsl_glm; Gannet 3.1.5 (MATLAB-based toolbox for MEGA-PRESS); LCModel (for conventional PRESS)
neuroimaging_methods.motion_exclusion_exact: rs-fMRI results confirmed not confounded by head motion (Supplementary Results F)
primary_neuroimaging_metrics: GABA+ (institutional units, approximating millimolar concentrations; MEGA-PRESS)
statistical_thresholds_exact: gaussian random field (GRF) cluster threshold (Z > 2.3) and significance at corrected p < 0.05
neuroimaging_methods.multiple_comparison_correction_exact: gaussian random field (GRF) cluster threshold (Z > 2.3), significance at corrected p < 0.05

extraction_notes.note: Full coordinate/cluster tables for all neuroimaging results are reported in Supplementary Results E, which was not provided. Coordinates could not be extracted. Only narrative descriptions of regions (bilateral aINS, pINS, right non-leg S1, left a/mINS) were available in the main text.
Full inclusion and exclusion criteria are in Supplementary Methods A, not provided. Only partial information available from main text.
Standardized verbal instructions used by acupuncturists are in Supplementary Methods B and C, not provided.
Credibility Questionnaire full results are in Supplementary Results D, not provided. Only the summary statement 'equal across both groups' is in the main text.
Full demographic and clinical characteristics, medication usage, and exploratory outcome data are in Supplementary Results B and C, not provided.
Head motion confound analysis for rs-fMRI is in Supplementary Results F, not provided.
Confirmation that GABA-BPI and connectivity-GABA relationships are specific to inhibitory (not excitatory) neurotransmitter changes is in Supplementary Results H, not provided.
Mediation results using GABA+/Cr as mediator are in Supplementary Results I, not provided.
Full PRESS and MEGA-PRESS acquisition parameters, preprocessing, and analysis details are in Supplementary Methods F, not provided. TR, TE, voxel size for spectroscopy not reported in main text.

Exact n per arm (n_assigned, n_completed, n_analyzed_clinical, n_analyzed_neuroimaging) were not reported in the main text. Total enrolled n=76 is stated. ANOVA degrees of freedom suggest n_analyzed_clinical=72 (df=70 for between-subjects, consistent with 72 participants). MRS analyses used smaller samples (r(16) for EA GABA analyses suggests ~18 EA participants; r(23) for ML GABA analyses suggests ~25 ML participants), but exact n per group per analysis varies and is not explicitly stated for all analyses.

TR, TE, voxel size, scan duration, smoothing, filtering, and global signal regression details for rs-fMRI acquisition were not reported in the main text. Full MRI acquisition parameters are in Supplementary Methods E.

Exact numeric values for BPI Severity pre- and post-treatment for EA and ML groups are only available from Figure 2A. Mean differences EA=-1.14, ML=-0.46 are stated in the abstract but pre/post absolute values are only in the figure.
Exact MASS Index values per treatment session are only available from Figure 2B. No numeric values are given in the text.
Neuroimaging brain maps and cluster overlays are in Figures 3A and 4B but coordinates cannot be read from figures in this PDF. Full coordinate tables are in Supplementary Results E.
The paper does not report adverse events in the main text. No statement about presence or absence of adverse events was found.

The paper does not explicitly state n per arm. The r(30) degrees of freedom for EA in S1leg-aINS/pINS correlations and r(16) for GABA analyses within EA suggest different subsets were used for different analyses, likely due to data quality exclusions for MRS. The exact reasons for variation in n are not explained in the main text.

Du-20, right ear shenmen, and left LV-3 received needle insertion but no electrical current was delivered. Whether these are classified as EA acupoints or manual acupuncture points is ambiguous; they are listed under the EA intervention.

The exact journal name is not reported in the provided manuscript pages. The article is published in Arthritis & Rheumatology based on the DOI 10.1002/ART.41620, but this is inferred from the DOI prefix and not stated in the provided pages.

Mediation path coefficients (β=0.323, SE=0.149, CI=[.007,.638] for X→M and β=-0.578, SE=0.275, CI=[-1.163,-.007] for M→Y) were read from Figure 5A which was partially legible in the provided PDF. These values should be verified against the published version.

The paper states the study took place from December 2014 to November 2019. The publication year is listed as accepted for publication but the exact publication year is not stated in the main text; 2021 is inferred from the DOI record context.
